description: This PHP source file defines the class Kint_Parsers_Color, which extends kintParser. It provides methods for parsing and converting CSS color representations, including named colors, hex, rgb, rgba, hsl, and hsla formats. The class includes color conversion utilities and a test data array for various color formats.

classes.name: Kint_Parsers_Color
classes.description: A parser class for CSS color values, capable of recognizing, converting, and displaying color formats.

methods.name: _parse
methods.description: Parses a variable to determine if it is a valid CSS color and generates an HTML preview with color details.

methods.name: _fits
methods.description: Checks if a string matches known CSS color formats or named colors.

methods.name: _convert
methods.description: Converts a color string into various formats: hex, rgb, hsl, and name.

methods.name: _HSLtoRGB
methods.description: Converts HSL color values to RGB.

methods.name: _hue2rgb
methods.description: Helper function for HSL to RGB conversion, calculates RGB component based on hue.

methods.name: _RGBtoHSL
methods.description: Converts RGB color values to HSL.
